raw.query: WITH dim_info AS (SELECT d.run_id, s.handoff_gbps, s.handoff_rtt_ms, (s.metrics->'handoff_ms'->>'p50')::numeric AS p50_ms, (s.metrics->'handoff_ms'->>'max')::numeric AS max_ms FROM provenance.v_dim d JOIN provenance.encoder_run_summary s USING (run_id) WHERE d.is_current = true AND d.run_id = 'sweeps:vision_head2k_s1'), fn_info AS (SELECT post_merge_tokens FROM provenance.collector_encoder_fn WHERE is_valid = true AND image_px = 448 AND n_images = 1 AND engine = 'sdpa' LIMIT 1) SELECT d.run_id, d.handoff_gbps, d.handoff_rtt_ms, d.p50_ms, d.max_ms, f.post_merge_tokens, (121::numeric * 4::numeric * f.post_merge_tokens::numeric * 4096::numeric * 2::numeric * 8::numeric / (d.handoff_gbps::numeric * 1e9) * 1000 + d.handoff_rtt_ms::numeric)::numeric(10,2) AS projected_max_handoff_ms FROM dim_info d, fn_info f;
raw.observed: sweeps:vision_head2k_s1 has default link handoff_gbps=25, RTT=0.2 ms, post_merge_tokens=196 (1.6 MB/image bf16), and baseline max_ms=62.37 (backing a 121-image request maximum). Quadrupling the payload (4 tensors) gives 6.4 MB/image, which takes 248.88 ms at the 121-image maximum.
raw.claimed: quadrupling the payload to ≈6.4 MB per image (≈250 ms at the 121-image maximum on the default link)
raw.evidence: Baseline steady-head run sweeps:vision_head2k_s1 supports a 121-image maximum (62.37 ms handoff max) on a 25 Gbps link. Quadrupled DeepStack payload is 6.4 MB per image and takes exactly 248.88 ms for 121 images.
